Four-class completeness is supported by the classical Chang classification. Only mod-two homology and its homotopy obstruction are claimed.

value.rationale: A complete isomorphism-closed four-class classification for a canonical strongly regular parameter family, rather than an arbitrary graph sample. All four are cospectral and have the same local intersection parameters; nonetheless their full reduced mod-two neighborhood Betti vectors are pairwise different. In particular all four topological homotopy types differ, a structural distinction that common graph spectra cannot reveal. The invariant is mathematically natural in Lovasz graph topology and related combinatorial Alexander duality. No unsupported extension beyond the finite family is claimed.
